name: flashcms
summary: Categories, photo gallery, custom pages + page duplication, post editor upgrades (inline image sizes, preview), client-side image compression + cropping, SendPipe email transport, and a batch of security/bug fixes (incl. a broken 0001 migration on fresh installs). Includes 1.0.9 newsletter.
notes: Snapshot cut from the sfh-group-website working codebase; 1.0.9–1.1.0 back-ported from sfh-nigeria-website.
See docs/extending.md for the pattern to add tables/blocks/routes.
See docs/updates.md → 'Upgrading an existing site to 1.1.0' for env, dependency, migration and snippet changes.

changes: Back-ports the generic CMS work from the sfh-nigeria-website codebase (includes 1.0.9 newsletter). SFH-specific blocks, routes, chrome and the where-we-work map were left out.

Categories — new post_categories table (migration 0008) + posts.category_id (0008) + pages.category_id (0009), ON DELETE SET NULL. lib/categories.ts CRUD (site-scoped), /admin/categories with inline create/edit/delete, category select in PostEditor, getPublishedPosts({ categorySlug }) + listVisibleCategories() in lib/blog.ts, updatePageCategory in lib/pages.ts. See docs/categories.md.

Photo gallery — new gallery_photos table (migration 0010, idempotent SQL), lib/gallery.ts, /admin/gallery list/new/edit with media picker, 16:10 crop, caption, sort order, visibility toggle. New components/GalleryLightbox.tsx (fullscreen viewer, thumbnails, keyboard nav), snippets/gallery-page.tsx, scripts/seed-gallery.ts (JSON import). See docs/gallery.md.

Custom pages — /admin/pages 'New page…' (createCustomPage) creates CMS pages at any kebab-case slug outside known routes and RESERVED_SLUG_ROOTS; listed under a 'Custom' group; editable at /admin/pages/<slug>; served by snippets/catch-all-page.tsx. savePage accepts custom slugs.
Page duplication — 'Duplicate from…' (duplicatePage) copies another page's published doc (or latest draft) into a known route or existing custom page as a new draft, optionally publishing.

Post editor — ResizableImage TipTap extension (lib/tiptap-extensions.ts, shared with server render) with small/medium/full sizes; image bubble menu (resize / replace / remove); sticky toolbar with prominent '＋ Insert image'; alt-text prompt; cover-image crop; 'factsheet' press type; Preview button (saveDraftForPreview) opening /blog/<slug>/preview (snippets/blog-preview-page.tsx) + components/BlogArticleLightbox.tsx.

Media — client-side image compression (components/compressImage.ts: >1.5 MB → ≤2400 px JPEG) in MediaUploader / MediaPicker / ImageCropModal with friendly over-limit errors; cap configurable via NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB (default 15). New components/ImageCropModal.tsx (react-easy-crop) crops a copy into the media library; 'Crop' badge on picker images. uploadMedia now returns { urls }. MediaField accepts /public paths (type=text).

Newsletter — email transport switched from nodemailer/SMTP to the SendPipe HTTP API (SENDPIPE_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, EMAIL_FROM_NAME) with a 10 s timeout; nodemailer dependency removed. Welcome email made brand-neutral with WELCOME_EMAIL_THEME / WELCOME_EMAIL_COPY extension points and HTML escaping; NewsletterForm gains consentLabel / inputId props.

Security fixes — email links use SITE_URL or sites.domain instead of the client-controlled Host header; admin newsletter, category and gallery mutations are site-scoped; category ids validated against the current site; admin gallery reads auth-gated; unsubscribe token validated as a UUID; ILIKE wildcards escaped in subscriber search; CSV export guards against formula injection; /admin/newsletter admin-only in middleware, sidebar and page.

Bug fixes — migration 0001 rewritten (drop + re-add accounts.expires_at) because its text → integer ALTER failed on every fresh install; page/post editors load the latest saved version so drafts survive reloads; GalleryPhotoEditor no longer nests a delete <form> inside the save form; previewing a new post no longer creates a duplicate row on the next save; duplicating into a custom page works; search skips unpublished custom pages; analytics referrer list tolerates malformed URLs; db/index.ts no longer throws at import time without DATABASE_URI; authed admin layout is force-dynamic.
render-cms-page — new renderCmsPage(slug, opts) returning null when unpublished (React-18-types friendly); buildCmsMetadata and og:site_name use sites.name; <CmsPage> kept for compatibility.

Scripts — scripts/migrate.ts (programmatic migrator; db:migrate now runs it, drizzle-kit kept as db:migrate:kit), scripts/dump-page.ts, scripts/publish-page.ts, scripts/compress-public-images.ts (sharp).

Snippets/docs — new snippets catch-all-page.tsx, gallery-page.tsx, blog-preview-page.tsx, cms-frontend.css; package.json.merge.json adds react-easy-crop, @tiptap/extension-bubble-menu, happy-dom, sharp; env.example adds SENDPIPE_KEY / EMAIL_FROM / EMAIL_FROM_NAME / SITE_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB (SMTP_* removed). New docs/gallery.md, docs/categories.md; updated newsletter, content-model, media-storage, updates (1.1.0 upgrade guide), INSTALL, ARCHITECTURE, README.
New newsletter module — table newsletter_subscribers (site-scoped, unique (site_id, email), per-row unsubscribe_token UUID) + migration 0007.
New lib/newsletter.ts server actions: subscribeToNewsletter (public), unsubscribeByToken (public), listSubscribers / subscriberCounts / adminUnsubscribe / adminResubscribe (admin).
New lib/email.ts — nodemailer over SMTP, provider-agnostic. No-ops with a warning when SMTP_HOST/USER/PASSWORD is missing, so subscribes still save.
New lib/emails/subscribe-welcome.ts — inline-styled branded HTML template. Logo pulled from site-settings.brand.imageUrl, so each site's mail carries its own logo without template edits.
New components/NewsletterForm.tsx — client form with required acknowledgement checkbox, pending/success/error states via useActionState.
New /admin/newsletter — filter tabs (Active/Unsubscribed/All), search, per-row toggle actions, top-right Export CSV button. Sidebar link added under Content.
New /api/newsletter/export — admin-only CSV (RFC 4180-safe), active subscribers only, filename <slug>-newsletter-<date>.csv.
New snippets/unsubscribe-page.tsx — drop at your frontend group's unsubscribe/[token]/page.tsx (per-site because (frontend) isn't part of the template).
New snippets/footer-newsletter.md — the two-line Footer.tsx change to wire in the new NewsletterForm.
SMTP env vars added to snippets/env.example. nodemailer + @types/nodemailer added to snippets/package.json.merge.json.

New app/api/search/route.ts — site-scoped search that scans pages.published, the latest page_versions draft, posts (published) + post_versions, plus known-routes labels and a per-project STATIC_NAV_TARGETS list. Extracts real text from Puck / TipTap JSONB via a recursive walker; returns 140-char snippets showing where each match was found; ranks exact-title > title starts-with > title contains > excerpt contains > everywhere.
New components/SearchOverlay.tsx — client overlay with debounced fetch, arrow-key navigation, keyboard shortcuts (↑↓ / Enter / Esc), grouped Pages + Posts results, and empty/no-match states.
Skip-list + heuristic filters image URLs (`/*.jpg`, `http://*`, `.pdf`, etc.) out of search snippets so results stay readable.
Template ships with STATIC_NAV_TARGETS = [] — populate per project for hand-coded sub-pages you want in search.

New docs/dynamic-blocks.md walks through the two-config pattern for data-driven blocks: client-safe placeholder in puck-config.tsx + async server override merged into serverPuckConfig in render-cms-page.tsx.
Recommends the hide-when-empty convention (dynamic blocks return null when the query is empty; the placeholder still renders in the editor so authors can arrange it).
README docs index links the new page.

PageEditor now passes `iframe={{ enabled: false }}` to <Puck>. The default iframe often fails to inherit parent stylesheets, leaving preview blocks unstyled. Disabling the iframe makes globals.css + puck-preview.css apply directly.
INSTALL Step 9a: adopt Next.js multiple-root-layouts pattern — move public routes into app/(frontend)/ and delete the shared root app/layout.tsx so admin chrome and public chrome don't nest.
No template code changes — pure docs.
Template's PageEditor.tsx now imports `@/app/globals.css` by default — matches the flat layout most Next.js projects use.
Docstring lists both common paths (flat vs route-group).
INSTALL.md Step 9b documents adjusting this import per-project.
lib/known-routes.ts entries now carry `section` and `icon` fields; the /admin/pages listing derives grouping and glyphs from the data instead of a hardcoded sectionFor() switch.
Template ships a minimal starter list (home + about) so a fresh install no longer inherits SFH-group's routes.
New knownSectionOrder() helper returns unique sections in first-appearance order.
INSTALL.md Step 9 documents the section/icon fields.
lib/site.ts now reads SITE_SLUG from env (falls back to 'sfhgroup' so existing installs keep working).
scripts/seed.ts reads SITE_SLUG / SITE_NAME / SITE_DOMAIN so one script can bootstrap any tenant.
snippets/env.example documents the new vars.
Enables installing flashcms into multiple Next.js projects that share one Postgres — pages, posts, media, and analytics are already foreign-keyed to sites.id.
Add TopProgress client component — global link/form click listener that shows a red progress bar at the top of the viewport during route transitions and clears when the new pathname lands.
Add loading.tsx skeleton fallback in app/(admin)/admin/(authed) so slow segment fetches render a shimmer instead of freezing the current UI.
Add busy cursor + prefers-reduced-motion fallback and 15s safety timeout so the bar never sticks.
Initial extracted release of flashcms.
Includes Puck page editor, TipTap posts, media library, users + roles, analytics (visits + Web Vitals), SEO, site-settings, in-CMS update flow, and a full admin UI.
